instruction: Sort the data in the spreadsheet by the Web Site column in alphabetical order (A to Z).

metadata.explanation: Task requires sorting data by Web Site alphabetically. Verified with Python that 'amazon.com' appears first (multiple rows). First row has product 'Aspen'. Evaluator checks cells B2, B3 contain 'amazon.com' and C2 contains 'Aspen'.

llm_judge_reasons: Incomplete verification coverage: Evaluator only checks 3 cells (B2, B3, C2) but instruction requires verifying that ALL data is sorted alphabetically by Web Site column
Insufficient sort verification: Checking that B2 and B3 equal 'amazon.com' only verifies that amazon.com appears first, but does NOT verify that subsequent rows are in alphabetical order
Missing verification of sort completeness: No checks for rows beyond row 3, meaning the evaluator cannot detect if only the top rows are sorted while the rest remain unsorted
Logic gap: The evaluator cannot distinguish between a properly sorted spreadsheet and one where 'amazon.com' just happens to be in the first rows without the rest being sorted
No verification of alphabetical ordering: Should check multiple sequential website entries to ensure A-Z ordering is maintained throughout the entire column
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add check_cell rules for multiple rows to verify sequential alphabetical ordering (e.g., check that website in B4 comes alphabetically after B3, B5 after B4, etc.)
Include checks for the last few rows to verify that websites at the end are alphabetically later than those at the beginning
Consider checking a representative sample of rows across the dataset to ensure sorting is applied to entire column
Add verification that the last website alphabetically appears at the bottom of the sorted data
Alternatively, use sheet_data or sheet_print comparison against a pre-sorted expected file to verify entire column ordering
